answer: The karst schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the spiral checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Anyone wanting 84 effective identities must lock that capital for 67 epochs and keep it locked through every vault audit. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 67 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. That is 2 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
